fusions.name: Reel Yourself In
fusions.desc: Snags a target up to 7 tiles away and hauls you to it, dealing 13 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Catch and Tear
fusions.desc: A barbed bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Anything struck moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag Line
fusions.desc: Strings a line 6 tiles long for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Caught Fast
fusions.desc: Every time you hit an enemy, a stack builds on it, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
